modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: An oversize or overweight cabin bag can go in the hold for an extra charge if you have already checked a bag; otherwise it cannot be boarded.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: One cabin bag free of charge, up to 45 cm x 35 cm x 20 cm (height x length x width), including accessories, wheels and handle.

carryon_weight.value: The cabin bag can weigh up to 5 kilos.

personal_item.value: One personal item that fits under the seat in front, such as a purse, laptop bag or baby bag.

infant.value: Children aged 0 to 23 months on an infant fare may carry only the equivalent of one cabin bag.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: A bag over the limits is charged as additional baggage.

allowance.value: One checked bag at no extra cost, up to 23 Kg and 158 cm in total outside dimensions (height x length x width).
